remarks:
Perfectly situated in the heart of downtown Buffalo, The HUB offers the best of city living. Enjoy being just steps from Sahlen’s Field, KeyBank Center, Canalside, the Casino, and countless dining and entertainment options. The HUB seamlessly blends modern design with the historic charm of Buffalo.
Each residence includes secure, gated parking and a spacious private storage locker — both included in the purchase price. Choose from 50 fully renovated units with thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom layouts. Residents enjoy exclusive amenities, including a stunning rooftop deck with 360° views of the Buffalo skyline, 24-hour access to the on-site fitness center, and all appliances — including an in-unit washer and dryer — for a true turnkey experience. The building also features vibrant commercial spaces, home to Hombre y Lobo, Every Body Plus, and Be You Evolution, adding to the community feel. HOA fees include water service for each individual unit. This unit is our renovated and elevated 2 bed, 2 bath unit.
